Interpretation: The client searches for the previously saved network profile.
The AP advertises a modified security configuration using TKIP instead of the baseline CCMP cipher.
The AP accepts the client's authentication request.
The client proceeds with association despite the modified cipher configuration.
The AP accepts the association request.
The client proves possession of the Pairwise Master Key.
The AP distributes group key material and installs session keys.
The client confirms key installation and completes the 4-Way Handshake.
